title: field_ops.custody.appended v1
description: Emitted for every row appended to the field_ops.custody_events ledger (chain of custody, append-only). Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.CustodyBroadcaster, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :custody, :appended] telemetry event from Custody.append_event. Only the telemetry metadata travels (no measurements); fields live under `data` (build_envelope/3). Note that `data.event_type` is the CUSTODY event type, not the envelope event_type.

order_id.description: field_orders row the event is about (UUID).

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the order (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

event_type.description: Custody event type. Today one of picked_up, transferred, arrived_site, handed_off, seal_verified, seal_broken, rejected (CustodyEvent @event_types). Consumers must tolerate new values (additive).
